divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: 23 hand-built VCF records at coding sites of chromosome 21 of the release-116 cache (a forward-strand and a reverse-strand coding exon) and one intergenic site, by locus and shape: an SNV, substitutions trimmed on both sides, on the left and on the right, a padded insertion and deletion, multi-allelic records that split under --minimal (an SNV beside an insertion, two substitutions, a repeated ALT, a repeated ALT beside an insertion, three ALTs of two shapes, a reverse-strand pair, an intergenic pair), records that do not (two SNVs, an insertion beside a `*`, an SNV beside a `*`, an insertion beside `<DEL:*>`), an ALT equal to the reference first and second, lower-case and mixed-case substitutions, a reverse-strand substitution and an ID-less record
generator: json_cache: the GRCh38-identifiers corpus's pruned cache; expected outputs: one Ensembl VEP 116.2 container run per format on the committed records, and one per format for each flag set, from the vep command recorded under its flag_sets entry: minimal-refhoms (the reference allele's row of every split feature) and minimal-pick (one row per record, the split features ranked in the order of their rejoin keys); manifest: classify on the manifest run and each flag set against the committed tree's binary
